C-RELEASE-0-4-1-254.Summary: Publish patch release 0.4.1 from a clean, fully merged and post-merge-verified main revision.
C-RELEASE-0-4-1-254.Problem: The document-runtime reliability work and desktop plans lifecycle improvement are merged and need a version-consistent, reproducible offline release with Russian release notes and verified artifacts.

Goals.Goal: Set every authoritative committed version marker to 0.4.1 without changing application behavior or SQLite schema.
Document the exact user-visible changes, compatibility boundary and excluded unfinished branches.
Build and verify the full offline artifact, systemd installation, update/rollback and strict OCR runtime gates.
Publish tag v0.4.1 and a non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub Release only from the exact verified main commit.

Constraints.Constraint: The release contains only commits already merged into main through completed GRACE lifecycles.
No historical, draft, unmerged or experimental branch is copied into the release.
No mobile mode, mobile navigation, bottom sheet, gesture or mobile-only transition is introduced.
No SQLite migration, destructive reset, Docker, CDN, mandatory Internet, cloud or mandatory LLM dependency is added.
Applied SQL migrations and immutable document sources remain unchanged.
Tag and GitHub Release are created only after the release PR squash merge and successful post-merge CI on the exact main commit.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Implement any remaining parent issue 236 source-row or plan-detail work.
Change the package-installation or database-recovery architecture.
Publish a prerelease or replace v0.4.0 assets.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: VERSION, package.json and package-lock.json agree on 0.4.1 and no authoritative marker remains at 0.4.0.
Release notes identify document-runtime reliability, Unicode-safe uploads, classified Docomator diagnostics and the desktop current/archive plans control.
Release notes explicitly exclude unfinished branches and mobile-specific modes.
Unit, integration, browser, release-gate, full offline Debian 12, systemd, backup/restore and GRACE final checks pass on one exact PR head.
The release PR is squash-merged, new main completes post-merge CI, and tag v0.4.1 points to that exact commit.
The GitHub Release is published, not draft/prerelease, contains Russian notes and exposes verified downloadable artifacts with SHA-256.
A separate archive-only PR leaves C-RELEASE-0-4-1-254 in terminal applied state.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The exact release commit, tag, release metadata, offline artifacts and checks all identify version 0.4.1 and preserve the 0.4.0 upgrade path.
